candidate_practices.name: Name the mismatch the intervention changes
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts specify an operational or statistical mismatch before introducing its remedy.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this makes the design rationale inspectable without implying causal validation.
candidate_practices.application: Replace a broad weakness claim with the failing condition, affected quantity, and corresponding intervention.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the diagnosis is speculative; present it as a hypothesis instead.

candidate_practices.name: Explain the unit of prediction or control

candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When no meaningful unit changes or conversion is undefined.

candidate_practices.name: Specify the recoverable object before guarantees
candidate_practices.source_observation: Theory abstracts delimit distributions, feedback regimes, or equivalence classes associated with their results.

candidate_practices.application: Attach each guarantee to its model class and output object; place negative results beside the conditions enabling positive ones.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: For exploratory findings without formal guarantees, retain empirical scope instead.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Exact assumptions, theorem statements, proof validity, and relationships between theoretical and evaluated settings.

candidate_practices.name: Turn structural analysis into an executable consequence
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts connect mathematical structure to a computation removed, reduced, or explained.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: readers can see what the theoretical contribution changes operationally.
candidate_practices.application: After the structural result, name the eliminated subproblem or resulting procedure.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the theorem contributes understanding without an operational consequence.

candidate_practices.name: Make the evaluation resolve the actual decision
candidate_practices.source_observation: These studies define evidence through distribution conditions, model separations, environment changes, or human judgments.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: decision-specific measurements expose information an aggregate score can hide.
candidate_practices.application: Name the decision the measurement supports and the axis across which its conclusion may change.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When that axis is irrelevant to the intended claim.

candidate_practices.name: Describe resources by the operations they enable
